Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

A top-tier cyberdeck, commonly used by stealth-runners.

Neuroport Cyberdeck Port Operating System. The Neuroport Cyberdeck Port can now only accept an Arasaka Shadow Cyberdeck, one of which is provided with purchase of this Operating System.

The Arasaka Shadow Mk.5 is a Cyberdeck with 5 slots that can install Programs or Hardware. When using this Cyberdeck to Jack In to a target’s Neuroport, the user gains a +1 bonus to the contested Check to remain unnoticed within the target’s neuroport. When using this Cyberdeck to Jack In to another Netrunner, the opposing Netrunner only becomes aware of the user’s presence within their Neuroport at the end of their next Turn. When using this Cyberdeck to Jack In stealthily to a Non-Neuroport Net Architecture (DL:GQ, pg. 4), the user gains a +2 bonus to their initial Interface Check to remain unnoticed.

Slots: 5

Foundry notes:

  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
